PRODUCT_NAME: Microscope Slides, Glass, 25 x 75mm, 45 degree Beveled Edges, Clipped Corners, Frosted, 1 End, 1 Side, 72/Box, 2 Boxes/Case (1 Gross)
DESCRIPTION:
Globes frosted microscope slides are produced using a unique chemical etching process. Slides have a smooth frosted finish that wont wear out slide marking pens. Slides are printed with Globe under the frosting area for orientation purposes. Choose from single sided or double sided frosted, and ground or beveled edges. Ground-edge slides are available with the following options: 90° corners (straight-edge) or safety corners.

Transportation and storage conditions considerably affect the quality and performance of microscope slides. Microscope slides should be stored in a dry place at constant room temperature. Slides should be stored on a pallet or shelf and not directly on a floor. Do not store slides and solvents together as the slide surface can turn hydrophobic. If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use. Standard shelf life for soda lime glass microscope slides is approximately 2 years if the above transportation and storage conditions are followed.

Slides are printed with Globe under the frosting area for orientation purposes. Choose from single sided or double sided frosted, and ground or beveled edges. Ground-edge slides are available with the following options: 90° corners (straight-edge) or safety corners.

Transportation and storage conditions considerably affect the quality and performance of microscope slides. Microscope slides should be stored in a dry place at constant room temperature. Slides should be stored on a pallet or shelf and not directly on a floor. Do not store slides and solvents together as the slide surface can turn hydrophobic. If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use. Standard shelf life for soda lime glass microscope slides is approximately 2 years if the above transportation and storage conditions are followed.

PRODUCT_NAME: United Scientific� SPRING SCALE CENTRIPETAL FORCE APPARATUS
DESCRIPTION:
The Spring Scale Centripetal Force Apparatus is a simple device that allows students to investigate the relationship in circular motion between the radius, the velocity of the moving object, and the external force required to maintain the motion. When students hold the white handle and carefully spin the rubber stopper overhead, it places tension on the string. The tension created is centripetal force on the string that pulls on the spring scale. The faster the student spins the mass, more force is exerted on the spring. The spring scale has a numbered scale, so students can directly see a numerical indication of the centripetal force.
Easy to adjust string length up to 24�
Easy to read 5N spring scale
Includes Activity Guide

PRODUCT_NAME: VELAB VE-S3 Binocular Stereoscopic Microscope
DESCRIPTION:
Ideal for secondary education, the VE-S3 is also capable of covering basic procedures in higher education. Its Greenough design allows three- dimensional observation of insects. Specifications
• Eyepieces: WF 10x/20 mm with rubber eyecups and diopter adjustment on one eyepiece
• Head: Binocular 45° inclined, with interpupillary distance adjustment between 55 - 75 mm / 2.16 - 2.95 in.
• Objective: Selectable 2X/4X (20 and 40 total increases), with objective cover
• Stand: Stative, robust and reinforced with epoxy paint finish
• Stage: Interchangeable between translucent white and double side white / black, with a pair of stage clips
• Focusing: Coarse anti-slip control knob
• Illumination: Transmitted and incident LED light with independent variable intensity control
• Power Suppply: 110-240V, 50/60 Hz AC adapter
• Dimensions: 7.87 x 14.05 x 10.23 in.

Accessories Included:
• Dust cover
• Operation manual
• Power cord

Warranty
• 10-years limited warranty

PRODUCT_NAME: Microscope Slides, Glass, 25 x 75mm, 45 degree Beveled Edges, Clipped Corners, Yellow Frosted, 72/Box, 20 Boxes/Case (10 Gross)
DESCRIPTION:
Globes color frosted microscope slides are offered in ten bright, attractive colors. The beveled edge microscope slide is ideal for performing blood smears. The highly polished edges are specially angled at 45° to provide a secure grasp during the smearing process. All microscope slides are printed with Globe under the frosting area for orientation purposes. They are pre-cleaned and ready to use.

Transportation and storage conditions considerably affect the quality and performance of microscope slides. Microscope slides should be stored in a dry place at constant room temperature. Slides should be stored on a pallet or shelf and not directly on a floor. Do not store slides and solvents together as the slide surface can turn hydrophobic. If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use. Standard shelf life for soda lime glass microscope slides is approximately 2 years if the above transportation and storage conditions are followed.

PRODUCT_NAME: Microscope Slides, Diamond White Glass, 25 x 75mm, Charged, 90 degree Ground Edges, Gold Frosted, 72/Box, 20 Boxes/Case (10 Gross)
DESCRIPTION:
Produced from quality white glass, frosted charged microscope slides provide the ideal surface for cell and tissue adhesion. These slides are ideal for use in histology, cytology and pathology, where the convenience of an adhesive slide saves the user time and money. They are available in assorted colors and are pre-cleaned and ready to use.

• Produced from quality optical white glass
• Charged surface allows cells and tissues to adhere to the slide
• Packed in high-quality white plastic boxes
• Dimensions: 25 x 75 mm
• Thickness: 1 to 1.2 mm

Transportation and storage conditions considerably affect the quality and performance of microscope slides. Microscope slides should be stored in a dry place at constant room temperature. Slides should be stored on a pallet or shelf and not directly on a floor. Do not store slides and solvents together as the slide surface can turn hydrophobic. If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use. Standard shelf life for white glass microscope slides is approximately 2 years if the above transportation and storage conditions are followed.

DESCRIPTION:

These slides are ideal for use in histology, cytology and pathology, where the convenience of an adhesive slide saves the user time and money. Transportation and storage conditions considerably affect the quality and performance of microscope slides. Microscope slides should be stored in a dry place at constant room temperature. Slides should be stored on a pallet or shelf and not directly on a floor. Do not store slides and solvents together as the slide surface can turn hydrophobic. If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use. Standard shelf life for white glass microscope slides is approximately 2 years if the above transportation and storage conditions are followed.

DESCRIPTION: General description  Micro Particles or Latex Beads, commonly known as polystyrene microparticles, are negatively charged colloidal particles. The microparticles are produced through a polymerization reaction of styrene under controlled conditions. The conducive environment of the reaction induces spontaneous coalescent bead formation. Micro Particles or Latex beads are supplied in aqueous solutions composed of polymer particles with water. Polystyrene′s refractive index at 589 nm is 1.5905 and 1.602 at 486 nm.  Application  Micro Particles or Latex Beads is used for a wide variety of applications like:      Electron Microscopy.   Cell Counter Calibration.   Immunodiagnostics, especially for latex agglutination tests, and   Phagocytosis Research.    Analysis Note  For every lot exact values of particle size and standard deviation are determined with an accuracy of 0.01 μm using a Coulter Multisizer.

PRODUCT_NAME: CONTACT SLIDES YM
DESCRIPTION: General description  Contact Slides YM are developed for easy and flexible microbiological monitoring of flat and curved surfaces. Each contact slide is individually sealed in the transparent and flexible primary backing film made from PET and provides a rectangular surface of 25 cm 2 . Rose-Bengal Chloramphenicol Agar is a selective medium for the enumeration of yeasts and molds. Chloramphenicol, streptomycin and Rose-Bengal are included as selective agents to inhibit bacterial growth. Rose-Bengal also restricts the size and height of colonies of the rapidly growing molds, thereby facilitates the detection of slow-growing fungi by preventing overgrowth.  Application  Contact Slides YM are designed for the determination of the yeast and mold count on dry, sanitized surfaces as well as personnel in controlled clean room environments of production lines, i.e. food and beverages as well as non-sterile and terminally sterilized pharmaceuticals. PRODUCT_NAME: Microscope Slides, Glass, 25 x 75mm, 90 degree Ground Edges with Safety Corners, Lilac Frosted, 72/Box, 20 Boxes/Case (10 Gross)
DESCRIPTION:
Globes color frosted microscope slides are offered in ten bright, attractive colors. The ground edge microscope slide with safety corners provide slightly clipped corners for comfortable handling and to prevent the risk of finger and hand cuts. All microscope slides are printed with Globe under the frosting area for orientation purposes. They are pre-cleaned and ready to use.

Transportation and storage conditions considerably affect the quality and performance of microscope slides. Microscope slides should be stored in a dry place at constant room temperature. Slides should be stored on a pallet or shelf and not directly on a floor. Do not store slides and solvents together as the slide surface can turn hydrophobic. If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use. Standard shelf life for soda lime glass microscope slides is approximately 2 years if the above transportation and storage conditions are followed.

• Dimensions: 25 x 75 x 1 mm
• Thickness: 1.1 mm
• Color frosted one end, one side

PRODUCT_NAME: Microscope Slides, Diamond White Glass, 25 x 75mm, Charged, 90 degree Ground Edges, Green Frosted, 72/Box
DESCRIPTION:
Produced from quality white glass, frosted charged microscope slides provide the ideal surface for cell and tissue adhesion. These slides are ideal for use in histology, cytology and pathology, where the convenience of an adhesive slide saves the user time and money. They are available in assorted colors and are pre-cleaned and ready to use.

• Produced from quality optical white glass
• Charged surface allows cells and tissues to adhere to the slide
• Packed in high-quality white plastic boxes
• Dimensions: 25 x 75 mm
• Thickness: 1 to 1.2 mm

Transportation and storage conditions considerably affect the quality and performance of microscope slides. Microscope slides should be stored in a dry place at constant room temperature. Slides should be stored on a pallet or shelf and not directly on a floor. Do not store slides and solvents together as the slide surface can turn hydrophobic. If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use. Standard shelf life for white glass microscope slides is approximately 2 years if the above transportation and storage conditions are followed.

• Operation: AC adapter (included) or 4 AA batteries (not included)

If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use. Standard shelf life for soda lime glass microscope slides is approximately 2 years if the above transportation and storage conditions are followed.

All microscope slides are printed with Globe under the frosting area for orientation purposes. They are pre-cleaned and ready to use.

Transportation and storage conditions considerably affect the quality and performance of microscope slides. Microscope slides should be stored in a dry place at constant room temperature. Slides should be stored on a pallet or shelf and not directly on a floor. Do not store slides and solvents together as the slide surface can turn hydrophobic. If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use. Standard shelf life for soda lime glass microscope slides is approximately 2 years if the above transportation and storage conditions are followed.

PRODUCT_NAME: Microscope Slides, Diamond White Glass, 25 x 75mm, Charged, 45 degree Beveled Edges, Safety Corners, White Frosted, 72/Box, 20 Boxes/Case (10 Gross)
DESCRIPTION:
Produced from quality white glass, charged microscope slides provide the ideal surface for cell and tissue adhesion. These slides are ideal for use in histology, cytology and pathology, where the convenience of an adhesive slide saves the user time and money. They are available in assorted colors and are pre-cleaned and ready to use.

• Produced from quality optical white glass
• Charged surface allows cells and tissues to adhere to the slide
• Packed in high-quality white plastic boxes
• Dimensions: 25 x 75 mm
• Thickness: 1 to 1.2 mm

Transportation and storage conditions considerably affect the quality and performance of microscope slides. Microscope slides should be stored in a dry place at constant room temperature. Slides should be stored on a pallet or shelf and not directly on a floor. Do not store slides and solvents together as the slide surface can turn hydrophobic. If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use. Standard shelf life for white glass microscope slides is approximately 2 years if the above transportation and storage conditions are followed.

• Design Features: Stability indicator, stackable design with optional storage cover, mechanical and software overload/underload protection, low battery indicator, auto shut-off, auto tare, span calibration mass included on models up to 620g capacity

PRODUCT_NAME: Microscope Slides, Diamond White Glass, 25 x 75mm, 45 degree Beveled Edges, Clipped Corners, Frosted: 1 End, 2 Sides, 72/Box, 20 Boxes/Case (10 Gross)
DESCRIPTION:
Diamond™ White Glass frosted microscope slides are produced using a unique chemical etching process. This provide the slides with a smooth frosted finish that wont wear out slide marking pens. Available with 90° or clipped corners and with single or double sided frosting. The slides are pre-cleaned and ready to use.

• Produced from quality optical white glass
• Chemically etched frosting
• Packed in high-quality white plastic boxes
• Dimensions: 25 x 75 mm
• Thickness: 1 mm

Transportation and storage conditions considerably affect the quality and performance of microscope slides. Microscope slides should be stored in a dry place at constant room temperature. Slides should be stored on a pallet or shelf and not directly on a floor. Do not store slides and solvents together as the slide surface can turn hydrophobic. If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use. Standard shelf life for white glass microscope slides is approximately 2 years if the above transportation and storage conditions are followed.

PRODUCT_NAME: Microscope Slides, Glass, 25 x 75mm, 90 degree Ground Edges with Safety Corners, Yellow Frosted, 72/Box, 2 Boxes/Case (1 Gross)
DESCRIPTION:
Globes color frosted microscope slides are offered in ten bright, attractive colors. The ground edge microscope slide with safety corners provide slightly clipped corners for comfortable handling and to prevent the risk of finger and hand cuts. All microscope slides are printed with Globe under the frosting area for orientation purposes. They are pre-cleaned and ready to use.

Transportation and storage conditions considerably affect the quality and performance of microscope slides. Microscope slides should be stored in a dry place at constant room temperature. Slides should be stored on a pallet or shelf and not directly on a floor. Do not store slides and solvents together as the slide surface can turn hydrophobic. If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use. Standard shelf life for soda lime glass microscope slides is approximately 2 years if the above transportation and storage conditions are followed.

• Dimensions: 25 x 75 x 1 mm
• Thickness: 1.1 mm
• Color frosted one end, one side

PRODUCT_NAME: Microscope Slides, Glass, 25 x 75mm, 90 degree Ground Edges with Safety Corners, Gold Frosted, 72/Box, 2 Boxes/Case (1 Gross)
DESCRIPTION:
Globes color frosted microscope slides are offered in ten bright, attractive colors. The ground edge microscope slide with safety corners provide slightly clipped corners for comfortable handling and to prevent the risk of finger and hand cuts. All microscope slides are printed with Globe under the frosting area for orientation purposes. They are pre-cleaned and ready to use.

Transportation and storage conditions considerably affect the quality and performance of microscope slides. Microscope slides should be stored in a dry place at constant room temperature. Slides should be stored on a pallet or shelf and not directly on a floor. Do not store slides and solvents together as the slide surface can turn hydrophobic. If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use. Standard shelf life for soda lime glass microscope slides is approximately 2 years if the above transportation and storage conditions are followed.

Transportation and storage conditions considerably affect the quality and performance of microscope slides. Microscope slides should be stored in a dry place at constant room temperature. PRODUCT_NAME: Microscope Slides, Diamond White Glass, 25 x 75mm, Charged, 90 degree Ground Edges, Orange Frosted, 72/Box
DESCRIPTION:
Produced from quality white glass, frosted charged microscope slides provide the ideal surface for cell and tissue adhesion. These slides are ideal for use in histology, cytology and pathology, where the convenience of an adhesive slide saves the user time and money. They are available in assorted colors and are pre-cleaned and ready to use.

• Produced from quality optical white glass
• Charged surface allows cells and tissues to adhere to the slide
• Packed in high-quality white plastic boxes
• Dimensions: 25 x 75 mm
• Thickness: 1 to 1.2 mm

Transportation and storage conditions considerably affect the quality and performance of microscope slides. Microscope slides should be stored in a dry place at constant room temperature. Slides should be stored on a pallet or shelf and not directly on a floor. Do not store slides and solvents together as the slide surface can turn hydrophobic. If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use. Standard shelf life for white glass microscope slides is approximately 2 years if the above transportation and storage conditions are followed.

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Microscope Slides, Diamond White Glass, 25 x 75mm, Charged, 90 degree Ground Edges, Blue Frosted, 72/Box
PRODUCT_NAME: Microscope Slides, Diamond White Glass, 25 x 75mm, Charged, 90 degree Ground Edges, Blue Frosted, 72/Box
DESCRIPTION:
Produced from quality white glass, frosted charged microscope slides provide the ideal surface for cell and tissue adhesion. These slides are ideal for use in histology, cytology and pathology, where the convenience of an adhesive slide saves the user time and money. They are available in assorted colors and are pre-cleaned and ready to use.

• Produced from quality optical white glass
• Charged surface allows cells and tissues to adhere to the slide
• Packed in high-quality white plastic boxes
• Dimensions: 25 x 75 mm
• Thickness: 1 to 1.2 mm

Transportation and storage conditions considerably affect the quality and performance of microscope slides. Microscope slides should be stored in a dry place at constant room temperature. Slides should be stored on a pallet or shelf and not directly on a floor. Do not store slides and solvents together as the slide surface can turn hydrophobic. If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use. Standard shelf life for white glass microscope slides is approximately 2 years if the above transportation and storage conditions are followed.

PRODUCT_NAME: United Scientific� TECTONICS MODEL SET - LEARNING ABOUT FAULTS, FOLDS AND PLATE MOVEMENTS
DESCRIPTION:
Demonstrate plate tectonic principles, plate boundary interactions and the geometry and relative motions of faulting of geologic layers using 3-D manipulative models.

Versatile kit contains a Fault Model Set of 5 manipulatives and a Tectonics Sand Layer Model. Use the Fault Model Set to demonstrate normal faulting (extension), reverse faulting compression) and horizontal slip faulting (shear). Use the Tectonics Sand Layer Model to explore orogeny -mountain building � of the Appalachian Mountains, including coal formation in the sedimentary Appalachian Basin and its coal seam, construct a sand layer model system mimicking a subduction zone of oceanic crust (Juan de Fuca Plate), and simulate the creation of the San
Andreas Fault. Also includes three hands-on geoinformation activities for students to work with metadata to map the continental shelf, learn about earth spot location to determine how fast tectonic plates are moving, and predict earthquakes using metadata for South Dakota.

All necessary materials to perform the demonstrations, including five different colors of sand, are included in the kit. A digital camera or video recorder (not included) is recommended for use in creating video clips that students can use for analysis.

Kit includes an access code to download interactive Teacher and Student Guides, videos, geoinformation data sets, and other resources.

All microscope slides are printed with Globe under the frosting area for orientation purposes. They are pre-cleaned and ready to use.

Transportation and storage conditions considerably affect the quality and performance of microscope slides. Microscope slides should be stored in a dry place at constant room temperature. Slides should be stored on a pallet or shelf and not directly on a floor. Do not store slides and solvents together as the slide surface can turn hydrophobic. If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use. Standard shelf life for soda lime glass microscope slides is approximately 2 years if the above transportation and storage conditions are followed.

PRODUCT_NAME: Microscope Slides, Glass, 25 x 75mm, 90 degree Ground Edges, Tan Frosted, 72/Box, 20 Boxes/Case (10 Gross)
DESCRIPTION:
Globes color frosted microscope slides are offered in ten bright, attractive colors. The ground edge microscope slide offers 90° corners and is perfect for use in automatic cover slip machines. All microscope slides are printed with Globe under the frosting area for orientation purposes. They are pre-cleaned and ready to use.

Transportation and storage conditions considerably affect the quality and performance of microscope slides. Microscope slides should be stored in a dry place at constant room temperature. Slides should be stored on a pallet or shelf and not directly on a floor. Do not store slides and solvents together as the slide surface can turn hydrophobic. If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use. Standard shelf life for soda lime glass microscope slides is approximately 2 years if the above transportation and storage conditions are followed.

PRODUCT_NAME: Microscope Slides, Glass, 25 x 75mm, 45 degree Beveled Edges, Clipped Corners, Frosted, 1 End, 1 Side, 72/Box, 20 Boxes/Case (10 Gross)
DESCRIPTION:
Globes frosted microscope slides are produced using a unique chemical etching process. Slides have a smooth frosted finish that wont wear out slide marking pens. Slides are printed with Globe under the frosting area for orientation purposes. Choose from single sided or double sided frosted, and ground or beveled edges. Ground-edge slides are available with the following options: 90° corners (straight-edge) or safety corners.

Transportation and storage conditions considerably affect the quality and performance of microscope slides. Microscope slides should be stored in a dry place at constant room temperature. Slides should be stored on a pallet or shelf and not directly on a floor. Do not store slides and solvents together as the slide surface can turn hydrophobic. If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use. Standard shelf life for soda lime glass microscope slides is approximately 2 years if the above transportation and storage conditions are followed.

PRODUCT_NAME: Microscope Slides, Glass, 25 x 75mm, 45 degree Beveled Edges, Clipped Corners, Blue Frosted, 72/Box, 20 Boxes/Case (10 Gross)
DESCRIPTION:
Globes color frosted microscope slides are offered in ten bright, attractive colors. The beveled edge microscope slide is ideal for performing blood smears. The highly polished edges are specially angled at 45° to provide a secure grasp during the smearing process. All microscope slides are printed with Globe under the frosting area for orientation purposes. They are pre-cleaned and ready to use.

Transportation and storage conditions considerably affect the quality and performance of microscope slides. Microscope slides should be stored in a dry place at constant room temperature. Slides should be stored on a pallet or shelf and not directly on a floor. Do not store slides and solvents together as the slide surface can turn hydrophobic. If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use. Standard shelf life for soda lime glass microscope slides is approximately 2 years if the above transportation and storage conditions are followed.

• Dimensions: 25 x 75 x 1 mm

PRODUCT_NAME: Microscope Slides, Diamond White Glass, 25 x 75mm, 90 degree Ground Edges, Frosted: 1 End, 1 Side, 72/Box, 20 Boxes/Case (10 Gross)
DESCRIPTION:
Diamond™ White Glass frosted microscope slides are produced using a unique chemical etching process. This provide the slides with a smooth frosted finish that wont wear out slide marking pens. Available with 90° or clipped corners and with single or double sided frosting. The slides are pre-cleaned and ready to use.

• Produced from quality optical white glass
• Chemically etched frosting
• Packed in high-quality white plastic boxes
• Dimensions: 25 x 75 mm
• Thickness: 1 mm

Transportation and storage conditions considerably affect the quality and performance of microscope slides. Microscope slides should be stored in a dry place at constant room temperature. Slides should be stored on a pallet or shelf and not directly on a floor. Do not store slides and solvents together as the slide surface can turn hydrophobic. If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use. Standard shelf life for white glass microscope slides is approximately 2 years if the above transportation and storage conditions are followed.

PRODUCT_NAME: Microscope Slides, Glass, 25 x 75mm, 45 degree Beveled Edges, Clipped Corners, Green Frosted, 72/Box, 2 Boxes/Case (1 Gross)
DESCRIPTION:
Globes color frosted microscope slides are offered in ten bright, attractive colors. The beveled edge microscope slide is ideal for performing blood smears. The highly polished edges are specially angled at 45° to provide a secure grasp during the smearing process. All microscope slides are printed with Globe under the frosting area for orientation purposes. They are pre-cleaned and ready to use.

Transportation and storage conditions considerably affect the quality and performance of microscope slides. Microscope slides should be stored in a dry place at constant room temperature. Slides should be stored on a pallet or shelf and not directly on a floor. Do not store slides and solvents together as the slide surface can turn hydrophobic. If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use. Standard shelf life for soda lime glass microscope slides is approximately 2 years if the above transportation and storage conditions are followed.

PRODUCT_NAME: Microscope Slides, Diamond White Glass, 25 x 75mm, Charged, 90 degree Ground Edges, Pink Frosted, 72/Box, 20 Boxes/Case (10 Gross)
DESCRIPTION:
Produced from quality white glass, frosted charged microscope slides provide the ideal surface for cell and tissue adhesion. These slides are ideal for use in histology, cytology and pathology, where the convenience of an adhesive slide saves the user time and money. They are available in assorted colors and are pre-cleaned and ready to use.

• Produced from quality optical white glass
• Charged surface allows cells and tissues to adhere to the slide
• Packed in high-quality white plastic boxes
• Dimensions: 25 x 75 mm
• Thickness: 1 to 1.2 mm

Transportation and storage conditions considerably affect the quality and performance of microscope slides. Microscope slides should be stored in a dry place at constant room temperature. Slides should be stored on a pallet or shelf and not directly on a floor. Do not store slides and solvents together as the slide surface can turn hydrophobic. If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use. Standard shelf life for white glass microscope slides is approximately 2 years if the above transportation and storage conditions are followed.

PRODUCT_NAME: Microscope Slides, Glass, 25 x 75mm, 45 degree Beveled Edges, Clipped Corners, Orange Frosted, 72/Box, 20 Boxes/Case (10 Gross)
DESCRIPTION:
Globes color frosted microscope slides are offered in ten bright, attractive colors. The beveled edge microscope slide is ideal for performing blood smears. The highly polished edges are specially angled at 45° to provide a secure grasp during the smearing process. All microscope slides are printed with Globe under the frosting area for orientation purposes. They are pre-cleaned and ready to use.

DESCRIPTION:
Globes color frosted microscope slides are offered in ten bright, attractive colors. The ground edge microscope slide with safety corners provide slightly clipped corners for comfortable handling and to prevent the risk of finger and hand cuts. All microscope slides are printed with Globe under the frosting area for orientation purposes. They are pre-cleaned and ready to use.

Transportation and storage conditions considerably affect the quality and performance of microscope slides. Microscope slides should be stored in a dry place at constant room temperature. Slides should be stored on a pallet or shelf and not directly on a floor. Do not store slides and solvents together as the slide surface can turn hydrophobic. If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use. Standard shelf life for soda lime glass microscope slides is approximately 2 years if the above transportation and storage conditions are followed.

If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use. Standard shelf life for soda lime glass microscope slides is approximately 2 years if the above transportation and storage conditions are followed.

If the temperature is constantly warming and cooling, condensation may occur, which can cause sticking of the slides. Slides should be allowed to reach room temperature prior to use.
